package_checks: Each skill folder is Markdown-only, has matching folder/name and local links resolve within its own folder; no symlinks or mandatory sibling dependencies.
privacy_check: Targeted identifier/path inspection of public skills and new evaluation artifacts; manual staged-diff review also required. This is not a general secret scanner or proof of absence of all sensitive data.
version_check: Current catalogue hashes and each evaluation input-to-snapshot hash checked; composition hashes match its current unchanged participating skills.
not_executed: Application build/tests locally: no app source/config changed.
Live integrations, campaigns, messaging or deployment.
